triage_summary.root_cause: Todo class uses @dataclass(slots=True) with default eq behavior that compares all fields. Objects are unhashable due to slots=True with mutable fields.
triage_summary.proposed_fix: Implement __eq__ and __hash__ based solely on the id field for semantic identity comparison.
risk_points: Breaking change: code relying on field-by-field comparison will behave differently
Mutable fields (done, updated_at) change but hashing on id is safe since id is immutable

implementation.approach: Added explicit __eq__ and __hash__ methods to Todo class based on id field. Used eq=False in dataclass decorator to disable auto-generated __eq__.

acceptance_criteria.same_id_equality: Todo(id=1, text='a') == Todo(id=1, text='b') returns True
acceptance_criteria.different_id_inequality: Todo(id=1, text='a') != Todo(id=2, text='a') returns True
acceptance_criteria.set_deduplication: Todo objects can be added to set and deduplicate by id
